title: Add to my to-do list
summary: Adds one or more tasks to the person's AI ToDo list on this device, to a list they name or their first list.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks to add something to their to-do list, a list of theirs, or to remember to do something.

arguments.name: items
arguments.description: The tasks, separated by commas, in their words

arguments.name: list
arguments.description: The list they named, such as 'Groceries'; empty for their first list

example: Add milk and eggs to my groceries list
_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the AI ToDo applet for the agent. A write: it adds to the person's own list, never deletes or changes items. Its tasks come from the person's words (or a list they point at), so it needs no material step.
